description: This file declares functions for parsing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and a function for converting IPv6 addresses to string format. It defines interfaces used for handling IP address parsing within the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into numeric components, with optional CIDR netmask and port.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv6
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into byte array, with optional network and port.

methods.name: li_ipv6_tostring
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address byte array into a string representation, appending to the provided GString.
